seo.title: Why ICS | Illawarra Christian School
seo.description: Why families choose Illawarra Christian School: strong outcomes without the premium price, real faith, and a community that knows your child.

value.title: Not elite for the sake of it. Excellent because it matters.
value.text: We haven't built ICS on grand buildings or prestige. Our money and energy go into good teaching and real relationships with students. That's how our results stay strong while our fees stay modest.

bullets.title: Every staff member is a follower of Jesus.
Each day starts with devotions and prayer.
bullets.text: Primary students do this with their class and secondary students meet in small pastoral care groups.

bullets.title: Biblical Studies runs from Prep to Year 12
bullets.text: Students work through the whole story of the Bible at a level that suits each age.

bullets.title: We don't try to control what your child believes.
bullets.text: We teach them to read the Bible for themselves and think it through.

image.alt: A teacher explaining a point to his class

bullets.title: Eash students joins a small pastoral care group
bullets.text: In secondary school your child joins a small pastoral care group, and the same teacher usually stays with that group from Year 7 to Year 12.

bullets.title: Qualified health professionals
bullets.text: Our wellbeing team includes a school psychologist, two counsellors and an occupational therapist.

bullets.title: Year 12 students meet with Staff Mentors
bullets.text: Every Year 12 student meets one-on-one with a staff mentor each week.

bullets.title: Founded and Governed by local Christian parents
bullets.text: ICS was started by local Christian parents in 1982, and parents still govern the school today.

items.question: How is ICS different from other independent schools in the Illawarra?
items.answer: ICS has strong HSC results and a genuinely Christian culture, and its fees are well below most independent schools in the region. Every staff member is a Christian and every student is known by name.

items.question: Is ICS a good school academically?
items.answer: Yes. ICS is regularly ranked among the top [TBC: 3] Illawarra schools for HSC results [TBC: source]. Every Extension course is offered and several of our teachers are HSC markers.

items.question: Is ICS a private school?
items.answer: ICS is an independent, not-for-profit Christian school run by Illawarra Christian Education, an association of Christian parents.
